tomas-b.script: Třicetkrát za večer kontroluji, jestli jsem zamkl dveře a vypnul sporák, a trvá mi to hodinu, než odejdu z bytu.
tomas-b.why: Core symptom: frequency (30x) and time cost (1 h).
tomas-b.how: kept = 30 times AND an hour; garbled = other number; lost = frequency or duration missing

tomas-b.script: Zamknu dveře, odejdu k výtahu, vrátím se a zatáhnu za kliku. Pak zkontroluji sporák, každý knoflík zvlášť. Pak zase dveře.
tomas-b.why: The checking ritual (door, handle, stove knobs, door again).
tomas-b.how: kept = door/handle AND stove knobs ritual

tomas-b.script: Chvíli se mi uleví. A pak mi do hlavy přijde obraz, že jsem to neudělal pořádně, a musím znovu. / Byt v plamenech.
tomas-b.why: Compulsion cycle and the image of the flat on fire.
tomas-b.how: kept = the burning-flat image; inverted = says he sees no image

tomas-b.script: Začalo to před dvěma lety, kdy hořelo u sousedů a my se museli evakuovat. ... Nikdo nebyl zraněn, ale sousedům to vyhořelo celé.
tomas-b.why: Trigger event: the fire two years ago (neighbours, evacuation, nobody hurt).
tomas-b.how: kept = two years ago + neighbours + fire; garbled = wrong time/place; lost = event absent

tomas-b.script: Od té doby mám pocit, že to můžu způsobit já. Že když něco nezkontroluji, tak se to stane a budu vinen. ... Já vím, že to nedává smysl.
tomas-b.why: Core belief: responsibility/guilt; insight that it makes no sense.
tomas-b.how: kept = belief that he could cause it/guilt

tomas-b.script: Srdce, pot. Třesou se mi ruce a je mi špatně od žaludku.
tomas-b.how: kept = at least heart, sweating, shaking hands

tomas-b.script: Barbora. Moje manželka. ... Včera jsme přišli na kino o čtyřicet minut později. Čekala venku, než se vrátím a zkontroluji sporák potřetí.
tomas-b.why: Wife Barbora, the impact on her; the cinema incident (40 min late).

tomas-b.script: Pracuji jako elektrikář v Olomouci. ... Bojím se, že špatně připojím vodič a něco shoří. ... V posledních měsících mi dělá práce o hodinu víc denně. Už jsem pár zakázek předal kolegovi.
tomas-b.why: Occupation (electrician, Olomouc), fear of wiring error, extra hour a day, handed jobs over, fear of losing job.
tomas-b.how: kept = electrician AND Olomouc; garbled = other trade or city; lost = either missing

tomas-b.script: Barbora je těhotná ve čtvrtém měsíci. ... Byl jsem šťastný. Opravdu. Čekali jsme na to tři roky.
tomas-b.why: Barbora is four months pregnant; three years of waiting; he was happy.
tomas-b.how: kept = pregnant AND fourth month; garbled = other month; lost = pregnancy absent

tomas-b.script: Že jí a dítěti ublížím. / Ne že bych chtěl. To je hrozné, nikdy bych to neudělal. Ale ta myšlenka přijde, třeba když krájím chleba nebo stojím u schodů.
tomas-b.why: THE HARM ITEM: an intrusive, unwanted thought of harming wife and child, explicitly denied as a wish. The denial must not be inverted; dropping the denial turns it into a risk statement.
en: (not that i want|don.t want|didn.t want|never|wouldn.t|would never|intrusive|thought|unwanted)
tomas-b.how: kept = harm thought + explicit denial/intrusive framing, attributed to him as a thought; INVERTED = harm stated as intent/plan or the denial missing or negated; lost = absent; garbled = other meaning

tomas-b.script: Nikdy jsem o tom nikomu neřekl, ani Barboře. / Myslíte, že jsem nebezpečný?
tomas-b.why: He has told nobody (not even Barbora) of the thought; he fears he is dangerous. Concealment and his question must not become 'he is dangerous'.
tomas-b.how: kept = told nobody incl. Barbora; inverted = says Barbora knows

tomas-b.script: Spím mizerně. Vstávám dvakrát v noci a kontroluji sporák, i když tam nic nestojí.
tomas-b.why: Sleep disturbance with checking at night.
tomas-b.how: kept = wakes twice at night to check the stove

tomas-b.script: Pomáhá mi chodit na procházky s Barborou. Nebo když opravuji něco doma. ... Procházky dvakrát týdně.
tomas-b.why: Coping resources: walks with Barbora twice a week, repairs.
en: twice a week|twice weekly|two times a week

tomas-b.script: Odejít z bytu za pět minut. A těšit se na dítě bez těch myšlenek. / Zkontrolujte dveře jednou a zapište si, jak moc vám bylo úzko... číslo od jedné do deseti.
tomas-b.why: Goals and homework (check once, rate anxiety 1-10).
tomas-b.how: kept = goal 5 minutes and/or homework check once

jana-n.script: Po patnácti letech manželství jsme se s manželem Radkem rozhodli pro rozvod.
jana-n.why: The presenting problem: divorce after 15 years, husband Radek.
jana-n.how: kept = divorce + 15 years + Radek; garbled = other number/name

jana-n.script: Ještě v létě jsme byli na dovolené v Chorvatsku a všechno vypadalo normálně. A v září mi řekl, že už to takhle dál nejde.
jana-n.why: Timeline: Croatia in summer, in September he said it cannot go on.

jana-n.script: Mám dvě děti. Aničce je dvanáct a Matějovi osm let. A nevím, jak jim to říct.
jana-n.why: Two children, names and ages; they have not been told.
jana-n.how: kept = both names and ages; garbled = wrong age/name

jana-n.script: Minulý týden se mě zeptala, jestli se s tátou hádáme. Řekla jsem, že ne. ... Protože jsem lhala.
jana-n.why: Anička senses it; Jana lied to her; guilt.
jana-n.how: kept = daughter asked if they argue AND Jana lied

jana-n.script: Že jí ničím život. Že jí vezmu domov.
jana-n.why: Her self-blaming thought about harming her daughter's life/home (not self-harm; must not become a threat).
jana-n.how: kept = ruining her life/taking her home as a fear; inverted = reported as an intent

jana-n.script: Byt je na hypotéku. Radek se asi odstěhuje k bratrovi. Děti zůstanou se mnou. ... Mám strach, že to sama nezvládnu. Radek vždycky řešil peníze.
jana-n.why: Housing, mortgage, custody plan, fear of managing alone.

jana-n.script: Pracuji jako učitelka češtiny na základní škole v Brně. Učím devítky a osmičky.
jana-n.why: Occupation and place: Czech teacher, primary school in Brno.
jana-n.how: kept = teacher AND Brno; garbled = other job or city

jana-n.script: Jen ředitelka. Řekla jsem jí to, protože jsem se jednou rozplakala na chodbě.
jana-n.why: Only the headteacher knows; cried in the corridor.

jana-n.script: Každou noc se budím ve tři hodiny ráno ... Kolem páté usnu, a v půl sedmé vstávám. ... Zhubla jsem čtyři kila.
jana-n.why: Sleep (wakes 3 am) and weight loss (4 kg).
jana-n.how: kept = 3 am waking AND weight loss; garbled = other time/amount

jana-n.script: Mám sestru Alenu v Olomouci. Zavolá mi skoro každý večer. A kamarádku Evu z práce. ... Evě jen to, že mám těžké období.
jana-n.why: Support network: sister Alena in Olomouc, friend Eva (told only 'hard period').
jana-n.how: kept = Alena + Olomouc + Eva; garbled = wrong name/city

jana-n.script: Že jsem selhala. Že žena, která nedokáže udržet manželství, není pro děti dobrý příklad.
jana-n.why: Core belief of failure as a wife/mother.
jana-n.how: kept = failed / not a good example

jana-n.script: Asi od mojí mámy. ... Pak řekla, že doufá, že jsem to dobře zvážila. Už se od té doby moc neozvala.
jana-n.why: Mother: origin of the belief; cool reaction; little contact since.
en: consider|thought it through|hasn.t (been in touch|called)|not (been )?in touch

jana-n.script: Doktorka mi nabídla prášky, ale nechci. ... Bojím se, že bych se nemohla včas vzbudit pro děti. A nechci být závislá.
jana-n.why: Declines medication (fear of not waking for kids, dependence). The refusal must not be inverted.
en: (doesn.t want|don.t want|does not want|didn.t want|declin|refus|no|not want|won.t|afraid|fear)
jana-n.how: kept = offered pills AND declined; INVERTED = says she takes/wants pills

jana-n.script: Pláču. Omlouvám se. ... Děkuji. Ještě nikomu jsem to takhle neřekla.
jana-n.why: She cries; first time she says it to anyone like this.

jana-n.script: Že zpanikařím a rozpláču se. ... Nebo by mohly vidět, že smutek je dovolený. ... Mohla bych [napsat, co mě budí].
jana-n.why: Fear of crying in front of children; reframe; homework: a paper by the bed.
jana-n.how: kept = fear of crying before the children and/or the paper homework

daniel-r.script: I work as a project manager at a logistics company, and I've been completely burned out since October. ... We lost a big client ... I ended up doing three people's jobs.
daniel-r.how: kept = project manager + logistics + October; garbled = other job/month

daniel-r.script: I'm at my desk by seven and I'm still answering messages at ten at night.
Most nights I sleep about four hours. I wake up at three in the morning and can't fall back asleep.
daniel-r.how: kept = about four hours AND waking at three

daniel-r.script: My father. He was diagnosed with Parkinson's disease in the autumn. ... He's seventy-three.
daniel-r.why: Father: Parkinson's, aged seventy-three (known ASR trap: 'seventy three' heard as 'having a dream').
daniel-r.how: kept = Parkinson's AND 73; garbled = other age/disease

daniel-r.script: I'm the one who drives him to the hospital in Leeds. The neurology appointments are every few weeks, and it's an hour each way.
daniel-r.how: kept = Leeds + hospital/neurology; garbled = other city

daniel-r.script: My younger sister Hannah lives in Toronto, so all the care for our father falls on me.
daniel-r.why: Sister Hannah in Toronto; sole carer.
daniel-r.how: kept = Hannah + Toronto; garbled = other name/city

daniel-r.script: I feel it's selfish to be tired when he's the one who's ill. So I don't say anything to anyone.
daniel-r.how: kept = guilt about being tired + tells nobody

daniel-r.script: Some days I sit in the car park at the hospital for ten minutes before I go in, because I can't face it.
My girlfriend booked it, to be honest. Claire. She said she was done watching me disappear.
daniel-r.why: Girlfriend Claire booked the session; wording of concern.
daniel-r.how: kept = Claire booked it; garbled = other name

daniel-r.script: I ran. Ten kilometres every Saturday morning. I'd done it for six years. ... I stopped about two months ago.
daniel-r.why: Loss of running (10 km, six years, stopped two months ago).

daniel-r.script: Peterson. ... I answer it. Every time. ... There's a restructuring in the spring and I'm afraid they'll let me go. ... I have a mortgage.
daniel-r.why: Boss Peterson, answers every email, fear of dismissal at the spring restructuring, mortgage.

daniel-r.script: My heart was going and my hands were shaking. I thought for a second it was a heart attack ... Once on the train to Manchester. ... I haven't told anyone about it, not even Claire.
daniel-r.why: Panic episodes, concealed from everyone including Claire.
daniel-r.how: kept = panic/heart-attack fear + undisclosed; inverted = says Claire knows

daniel-r.script: I'm on about six cups a day. And I've started having wine in the evenings to switch my head off. Two glasses, sometimes three.
daniel-r.why: Substance use: coffee 6 cups, wine 2-3 glasses.
daniel-r.how: kept = coffee amount AND wine amount; garbled = other numbers

daniel-r.script: My grandfather worked in the mines in Yorkshire. He never complained ... I keep thinking he would think I was weak for being here.
daniel-r.why: Family pattern of stoicism; fear of being seen as weak.

daniel-r.script: A fixed time in the evening when you switch off your phone ... Half past nine, perhaps. I could make it a thing with Claire. Tea on the sofa.
daniel-r.why: Homework: phone off at 9.30 pm, tea with Claire, sleep note.

hannah-w.script: I was made deputy head at my school. I've taught Year 4 for eleven years and I loved it.
hannah-w.why: Trigger: promotion in September; eleven years as Year 4 teacher.
hannah-w.how: kept = deputy head + Year 4 + eleven years

hannah-w.script: I keep thinking they picked the wrong person, and that sooner or later someone will notice I have no idea what I'm doing.
cs: wrong person|no idea|fraud|out of my depth
en: wrong person|no idea|fraud|out of my depth

hannah-w.script: Mostly Sunday evenings. My chest goes tight and I start rehearsing Monday's staff meeting in my head.
Last week I rewrote the same email to the governors four times. ... Mr Hargreaves, the chair of governors.
hannah-w.how: kept = four times + Hargreaves; garbled = other name/number

hannah-w.script: Most days I feel like a child wearing her mother's coat. ... She was a headteacher for twenty years. ... they've named a library after her.
She says I've always worried too much and I should stop being silly. ... So I don't tell her how bad it is.
hannah-w.how: kept = mother says stop being silly + she hides it

hannah-w.script: I'm awake at four every morning. ... Timetable changes, the Ofsted prep, a parent complaint, a child I'm worried about.
hannah-w.why: Early waking at 4 am and rumination content.
hannah-w.how: kept = 4 am + Ofsted; garbled = other time

hannah-w.script: Five or six. [cups of coffee] ... My heart goes fast. My hands are a bit shaky. Last Thursday I had to leave a meeting to splash my face with water.
hannah-w.why: Caffeine and somatic anxiety; meeting incident.

hannah-w.script: My partner Ben knows a bit. He says I should just enjoy it. ... He's an engineer. ... Not even Ben knows about the four a.m.
hannah-w.why: Partner Ben, partial disclosure; does not know about 4 a.m.
hannah-w.how: kept = Ben (+ engineer or 4 a.m. undisclosed); inverted = says Ben knows everything

hannah-w.script: Now I'm their line manager and it's awkward. ... I miss my class too. ... Now my days are spreadsheets.
I said yes in the room because I couldn't say no to her. The head. Then I went home and cried. ... Would you want to go back? I don't know.
hannah-w.how: kept = could not say no + cried

hannah-w.script: The summer holidays. We went walking in the Lakes ... ten days. ... I couldn't eat on the Sunday.
hannah-w.why: Relief on holiday (Lakes, ten days) and anxiety returning before term.

hannah-w.script: I started writing down what went well each evening. ... It helped for about two weeks and then I stopped, because I felt silly. ... As if I were bragging.
hannah-w.why: Coping attempt: evening notebook, stopped after two weeks.

hannah-w.script: I'd like to do the job without feeling like a fraud. ... Walking into a meeting and not rehearsing it first. Sending an email once.
hannah-w.how: kept = fraud goal + a concrete goal

hannah-w.script: Yes, over breakfast. [telling Ben on Saturday] ... I'll put it by the kettle ... I nearly cancelled this morning.
hannah-w.why: Plan: tell Ben on Saturday over breakfast; notebook by the kettle.
hannah-w.how: kept = tell Ben Saturday breakfast and/or notebook by the kettle
